title: Silver Fir: Ancient Silver Firs You Can Visit
meta_description: The fir of central Europe's mountain forests. The Waldhaustanne in the Bavarian Forest, Germany's tallest and oldest, is about 605 years old.
intro: A silver fir this old is rare precisely because the species is not: Abies alba covers mountain slopes across central Europe by the million, so a single named, individually remarkable specimen stands out against a background of forestry. The Waldhaustanne in the Bayerischer Wald is Germany's tallest, thickest and oldest documented silver fir, unrecorded until a family out walking reported it in 2020: about 53 metres tall, 6.93 metres round and roughly 605 years old, reached by a boardwalk built to keep boots off its roots. In Romania's Southern Carpathians the Guardian of Cibin, about 500 years old, takes eight men with outstretched arms to circle. On Velebit, Croatian foresters call Jela Car, the emperor fir, the largest silver fir left in Europe. Aarhus's stands forty and a half metres over a family graveyard moved into Moesgård's park in 1926.
